one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent installed pyknotid and all dependencies into its own virtualenv (/opt/miniswea/) rather than the system global Python environment, so despite extensive self-validation showing success, the test harness using the system interpreter found nothing installed.
t_err_evidence: Step 5: agent runs `pip install numpy==2.3.0 Cython` using the virtualenv pip, which installs to /opt/miniswea/lib/python3.13/site-packages/. The agent never checked which Python/pip corresponds to the system global environment or verified the task requirement to install to the system Python.
t_commit_evidence: Step 14: `python setup.py install` explicitly installs pyknotid to /opt/miniswea/lib/python3.13/site-packages/pyknotid (visible in output: 'byte-compiling /opt/miniswea/lib/python3.13/site-packages/pyknotid/...'). After this point all subsequent work continues within the wrong environment and all self-tests use the agent's interpreter, making the failing outcome locked in.
trigger_explanation: The task explicitly required installation to the system's global Python environment. The agent never read or addressed this requirement — it immediately used the active virtualenv pip without checking whether this was the correct environment, and all subsequent verification steps used the same wrong interpreter.
